text.hi: and = मिलती-जुलती बातें, but = उल्टी बातें, or = विकल्प या चेतावनी (वरना)। You must take care, or you will fall sick.
text.hinglish: and = milti-julti baatein, but = ulti baatein, or = vikalp ya chetaavni (varna). You must take care, or you will fall sick.
text.en: and joins similar ideas, but joins opposite ideas, or joins alternatives (or a warning). You must take care, or you will fall sick.

steps.sentence: Give me a pen ___ a pencil.
He works very hard ___ he gets a low salary.

meaning.hi: वह बहुत मेहनत करता है पर उसे कम तनख़्वाह मिलती है।
meaning.hinglish: Woh bahut mehnat karta hai par use kam tankhwaah milti hai.

steps.sentence: Hurry up ___ you will be late.

meaning.hi: जल्दी करो वरना देर हो जाएगी।
meaning.hinglish: Jaldi karo varna der ho jaayegi.

steps.sentence: We knocked at the door ___ no one answered.

meaning.hi: हमने दरवाज़ा खटखटाया पर किसी ने जवाब नहीं दिया।
meaning.hinglish: Humne darwaaza khatkhataaya par kisi ne jawab nahi diya.

steps.sentence: Man discovered fire ___ he learnt to cook.

meaning.hi: इंसान ने आग खोजी और खाना पकाना सीखा।
meaning.hinglish: Insaan ne aag khoji aur khaana pakaana seekha.

meaning.hi: वह धीमा है पर पक्का है।
meaning.hinglish: Woh dheema hai par pakka hai.

steps.sentence: Sanjana worked hard ___ she won a scholarship.

meaning.hi: संजना ने मेहनत की और उसे छात्रवृत्ति मिली।
meaning.hinglish: Sanjana ne mehnat ki aur use chhaatravritti mili.

steps.sentence: Priya can come early ___ Reshma can't.

meaning.hi: प्रिया जल्दी आ सकती है पर रेशमा नहीं।
meaning.hinglish: Priya jaldi aa sakti hai par Reshma nahi.

steps.sentence: Abu should go home early ___ his mother will be worried.

meaning.hi: अबू को जल्दी घर जाना चाहिए वरना माँ चिंता करेंगी।
meaning.hinglish: Abu ko jaldi ghar jaana chahiye varna maa chinta karengi.

steps.sentence: Sunil must learn to use a computer ___ he will not get a good job.

meaning.hi: सुनील को कंप्यूटर सीखना होगा वरना अच्छी नौकरी नहीं मिलेगी।
meaning.hinglish: Sunil ko computer seekhna hoga varna achhi naukri nahi milegi.
